correctness.rationale: In the rooted predecessor language the least cardinality of a finite exceptional set is μ(T)=Σ_{level-one x}δ(x)+ε(T), with infinity for unbounded mismatches: naming a child or descendant fixes its ancestors, so every child-star that deviates from the common degree requires a distinct anchor; already anchored root branches need no extra root anchor, while unanchored regular branches of exceptional shape each require one. Conversely choosing such anchors makes all remaining unanchored siblings isomorphic, giving a back-and-forth extension of each finite partial isomorphism. In the explicit computable presentation, a first-entry stage (if any) creates exactly one leaf child beneath x_n, whereas every non-entry stage creates a padding root child with exactly one leaf through the computable non-entry enumeration π_n. Thus root branch shapes (1,0) occur infinitely and (0,0) occur once for every n outside W, so μ(T_W)=|ω\W| when finite and ∞ otherwise. Finite prefixes and count identities independently checked; infinitude follows from the construction, not the truncation.

originality.rationale: Adams–Cenzer (arXiv:1608.01254), §7 Theorem 7.11 and Proposition 7.13, already characterize qualitative weak ultrahomogeneity and the local finite-exception condition for height-three predecessor trees. This result does not claim those as new. The numerical minimum formula and uniform coding of the exact complement cardinality of an arbitrary c.e. set are a distinct quantitative statement not stated in the inspected source. Targeted Resultary and literature searches did not establish prior coverage; novelty remains best-of-knowledge, not proven by absence of hits.
residual_risks: Other computable-model-theory work may refine Adams–Cenzer exceptional-subtree minimality to the exact μ(T), and such a general formula might imply a quick specialization.
The result applies to predecessor-function trees of height at most three, not relational rooted partial orders or higher trees; local infinitude proof uses unbounded stage enumeration.

value.rationale: The minimal number of named parameters is a natural invariant measuring failure of Fraïssé ultrahomogeneity. Uniformly realizing every finite value via complement sizes, while sharply detecting noncofinite sets by infinity, gives a mathematically motivated computable-model-theory coding theorem beyond a simple true/false rephrasing of the predecessor-tree classification.
